text_block_list.text: One of this year's target races, the Tenno Sho (Spring), is about to begin—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
My hobbies are ballroom dancing,
ballet, flower arranging, and martial arts!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Truly pure and dainty! The bewitching Umamusume, Lady Gold Ship, has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho!
I shall show you a beautiful victory today as well!

I'm not quite sure where this energy is coming from,
but she certainly seems motivated!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Let us have another fine contest today,
Golshi-san.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I knew you'd be here too!
When they said 'formidable rival', I figured it had to be you!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Well, today's the day I beat 'em to an absolute pulp with my sensational running—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I shall polish you until you are gleaming and sparkling bright! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...
I look forward to working with you.
The showdown against the formidable Eishin Flash begins!
